items.text:
Let it be.

The one "unanswered" line was `Throw bone` — and it wasn't silence: the verb I added last turn caught it and gave him a real refusal that named the troll and pointed him at `drop`. He read it, swung, killed the troll, and took the key. He's four commands from the door with a chisel, a spoon, a shortsword and the second stone out of the wall in his name. He also prayed, and was already answered. Nothing here needs a voice from the air.
